raw_content:
rules:
- id: "vuln-notesnook-e87f5e5f"
  pattern: |
    `${$SRC}?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw`
  pattern-not: |
    `${$SRC}?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw` + $OTHER
  languages: ["typescript"]
  message: |
    Potential XSS vulnerability due to direct concatenation of user-provided source URL into HTML attribute without proper sanitization. This can allow attackers to inject malicious scripts through the src parameter. The fix involves creating a DOM element and using its outerHTML property to properly escape the URL. Always sanitize dynamic content before injecting into HTML attributes.
  severity: ERROR
  metadata:
    source-url: "github.com/streetwriters/notesnook/commit/e87f5e5f899f45df28d7c0f33f15e9178d1fbcb7"
    category: security
    cwe: [79]
    owasp: [A03:2021 - Injection]
    references:
      - "https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/encodeURIComponent"
      - "https://owasp.org/www-community/attacks/xss/"
    technology: [typescript]
